title: Doctor diagnose session not tied to health warning banner content
body:
John 2026-07-28 (Puter / Anchor dashboard):

The Doctor diagnosis session was not tied to the health warning banner — it did not know what was in the banner. That should not be the case.

Expected:
- Clicking Diagnose from (or because of) a health warning banner must seed the Doctor session with the banner issue payload: issue id, title/body, severity, lastError, suggested checks, report date/path, and any diagnose=1 navigation context.
- The Doctor session must open already knowing which banner issue it is diagnosing — not a generic blank Doctor shell that rediscovers nothing about the warning the human just clicked.
- Banner → Doctor is a 1:1 handoff of the visible warning, not an unbound new session.

Success criteria for sleep:
1. Banner click / diagnose deep-link carries the full issue context into the Doctor session seed (not only diagnose=1 with empty issue).
2. Doctor first turn / shell text names the specific banner issue and its facts.
3. Diagnose run uses that issue as the primary focus (and fix path targets it when hygiene-related).
4. If context fails to attach, UI shows an honest error — never a silent generic Doctor session that looks successful but is uninformed.

Related open friction:
- 2026-07-28-03-anchor-doctor-diagnose-must-run-and-fix (diagnose must run + fix + all engines)
- W9 banner diagnose plan code paths in anchor_gui (async diagnose start, navigation from banner) — live behavior still loses banner content.

Sleep intake: docs/friction/2026-07-28-SLEEP-INTAKE-usage-restart-doctor.md (append Defect 3b / banner binding).
